Short video clip of the bike powering on and riding under load.

Video of the scooter starting up and riding briefly to confirm motor/controller function
Photos from front, rear, and the opposite side to check for hidden damage
Photo of the dashboard/odometer to gauge usage

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used electric scooter/bike by type, but battery condition, motor function, and hidden damage are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (non-working, battery needing replacement) until proof is supplied.
